Market today: Inflation is still the main worry, even with some softer data. Tech/chip names are sensitive to this and interest rate talk.

Your holdings: SOXL (-34.21%) and SPAL (-31.89%) are the big red flags needing attention. They are leveraged ETFs and decay is a killer, especially on margin.

Watch: Google's AI progress (Gemini 4 Argon) and the California AI law.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching AI developments.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged position given the significant loss and decay risk.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF due to the large loss and decay.
METU: This leveraged ETF is showing a 'SELL' status on your scanner, despite a positive PnL. Given its leveraged nature and decay, consider trimming.
